assumptions.statement: The normalized microscopic law and coarse map are fixed independently of the recognition law.
The admitted spaces and maps support the regular conditional probabilities used by KL disintegration.
The retained coarse variables are sampled values of the finite agents' belief, model, support, frame, and link sections.
Any continuum claim uses a declared refining mesh, base measure, interpolation topology, boundary conditions, and gauge treatment.

evidence.scope: Exact finite-lattice KL contraction and density-action identity.
side_conditions: Fixed Q-independent microscopic law and coarse map

evidence.scope: Typed classification of PIFB2 sectors after exact contraction.
side_conditions: Base refinement rather than population limit

evidence.scope: Fisher-gradient and compact Wilson-plaquette scaling calculations.
side_conditions: Uniform mesh and smooth link consistency
Compact unitary gauge representation for Wilson sector

evidence.scope: Counterexamples to generic locality, live-peer fixed-joint exactness, undressed GL positivity, and action-to-process inference.
side_conditions: Claims are refuted only at their stated universal scope

evidence.scope: Independent reconstruction of the strongest partial theorem and its boundary.
side_conditions: No use of PIFB2 action as a microscopic premise

evidence.scope: Oracle-erasure test separating ELBO derivation from PIFB operator selection.
side_conditions: PIFB2 and MAgent removed from the premise

evidence.scope: Revision-bound map to the live exact coarse-action and interaction-projection results.

claims.statement: For an arbitrary fixed finite number N of section-valued agents over either a finite oriented lattice or a compact contextual base with a refining lattice family, determine sufficient hypotheses under which an independently specified normalized microscopic joint law and its exact ELBO induce, by exact contraction to declared coarse section variables followed by a controlled local truncation, a PIFB2-type effective action; classify every self, peer, observation, base-gradient, connection, curvature, entropy, normalization, and correction sector as exact, conditional, truncated, or open, and determine what is required for a continuum limit.
claims.quantifiers: For every fixed finite N >= 1 and every admitted finite lattice, seek an existential construction under explicit hypotheses; for a continuum base, require a declared refining lattice family and state separately whether deterministic action convergence and process-law ELBO convergence hold.
claims.falsifier: A complete release would require a specified microscopic family, an exact or controlled PIFB projection, and the requested continuum convergence proof; any failed normalization, residual, or compactness premise defeats it.

claims.statement: A fixed normalized microscopic posterior and fixed measurable coarse map induce an exact finite-lattice coarse VFE and a coarse Radon-Nikodym density action.
claims.quantifiers: Every fixed finite N and admitted finite lattice under the declared disintegration and normalization hypotheses.
claims.falsifier: Exhibit recognition dependence, failure of disintegration, or a coarse law for which the KL chain rule identity fails.

claims.statement: The exact coarse ELBO equals expected density action plus recognition entropy, partition normalization, evidence normalization, and the conditional-KL correction before minimization.
claims.quantifiers: Every admitted coarse law with the displayed Radon-Nikodym derivatives and finite terms.
claims.falsifier: Produce a normalized dominated example violating the Radon-Nikodym KL expansion.

claims.statement: An explicit fixed source-label latent variable yields categorical attention KL, row entropy, softmax minimizer, and correlation corrections exactly.
claims.quantifiers: Every finite nonempty source set with positive fixed priors and integrable sample-state energies.
claims.falsifier: Show an admitted fixed-label model whose categorical KL fails to expand into the stated energy and entropy terms.

claims.statement: A nonzero live-peer KL between current recognition marginals is generically representable as an ordinary fixed-joint state-level ELBO on an open product-recognition family.
claims.quantifiers: Every positive fixed two-agent binary joint and an open set of Bernoulli product recognition laws.
claims.falsifier: The derivative counterexample is falsified by a Q-independent positive joint reproducing the live-peer KL on an open Bernoulli parameter set.

claims.statement: Same-agent neighboring-base KL terms with the correct link consistency and h scaling converge on smooth sequences to a Fisher-covariant Dirichlet density.
claims.quantifiers: Every fixed finite N, regular dominated statistical family on a compact regular stratum, and sufficiently fine uniformly regular mesh.
claims.falsifier: A regular family or smooth link-consistent sequence violates the second-order Fisher expansion or its h scaling.

claims.statement: Compact-group Wilson plaquette terms with h^(d-4) weights converge on smooth sampled connections to the quadratic curvature density.
claims.quantifiers: Every smooth compact-group connection in a finite-dimensional unitary representation on a uniformly refining mesh.
claims.falsifier: A smooth compact connection and consistent plaquette sampling violate the small-holonomy trace expansion.

claims.statement: Exact contraction generically closes on only the local pairwise PIFB2 operator sectors with zero residual.
claims.quantifiers: All normalized finite microscopic laws and all admitted coarse maps.
claims.falsifier: Refute the Gaussian or hidden-spin generated nonlocal/higher-body interaction examples.

claims.statement: For the current intended PIFB2/MAgent microscopic family, the exact coarse action has a PIFB2 retained projection whose residual vanishes uniformly on bounded-energy sublevels as the base lattice is refined.
claims.quantifiers: Every fixed finite N and the intended refining lattice family after the microscopic family and projection norm are fixed.
claims.falsifier: A nonvanishing generated operator or residual sequence refutes controlled closure; a uniform residual theorem would verify it.

claims.statement: The retained PIFB2 lattice actions Gamma-converge to a gauge-covariant continuum section action for fixed finite N.
claims.quantifiers: The intended refining mesh family, section topology, boundary data, and gauge quotient after all are explicitly fixed.
claims.falsifier: Failure of equicoercivity, liminf, recovery, topology control, or residual convergence defeats the claim.

claims.statement: The exact coarse probability-law ELBOs converge to a continuum process-law ELBO on a section space.
claims.quantifiers: The intended refining family with a common Polish embedding and normalized reference/process laws.
claims.falsifier: Failure of tightness, relative-entropy liminf/recovery, projective consistency, or partition convergence defeats the claim.
